ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; over 90% of the visible surface consists of low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels, with sparse <5% high-intensity white pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black area across both lobes; high-contrast white circular pixel clusters located primarily at the distal tips (bilateral) and sparsely distributed as individual points across the medial fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 50-degree V-shaped central depression with a deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration; sequence of sharp peaks and shallow valleys across the trailing edge; a significant notch is visible approximately 30% inward from the right distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve leading to sharply tapered, upward-sweeping distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density white pixel clusters at the far right and left tips; multiple isolated white circular blobs (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) scattered across the interior of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel, diagonal grey linear pixel streaks on the right lobe, oriented approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal axis; one vertical linear mark visible on the lower-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three prominent parallel rake marks (linear scars) on the right lobe; extensive barnacle-induced white scarring/clusters on the outer-most distal edges of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced cluster of high-intensity white pixels and irregular physical protrusions on the extreme right tip, indicating heavy barnacle colonization or permanent scar tissue.
